annotations.title: Recorded series: bars or points of one metric for one perpetual (price, OI, funding, CVD, liquidations, long/short, RSI and more)

description: Call this when the user wants the history of one recorded metric for one perpetual as a time series: price candles, volume, perp or spot CVD, open interest, funding (one venue, or OI-weighted across every venue as funding_agg), liquidations, long/short ratios, RSI, the Coinbase premium, US spot ETF flows, borrow rates or Hyperliquid whale net flow, for charting, backtesting or "what did X do over the last N days". Returns the /api/series answer (points as [t, v], or [t, o, h, l, c, v] for price, with unit, kind, source and source_kind, the bars served and whether member depth applied) plus provenance. metric is one of: price, volume, cvd_perp, cvd_spot, oi, funding, funding_agg, liquidations, long_short, top_traders, rsi, premium, etf_flow, borrow, whale_net (unit, finest period and venue support of each: https://bykaranteli.com/api/series/metrics). The Free plan gets public depth: fewer bars and no bars under 15 minutes (1m, 3m, 5m, 10m); Builder and higher plans get member depth; the bar limits are in the same list. The answer names the venue it was read from (venue) and every venue a market-wide series sums (venues). Without from or limit, the newest 300 bars; pass limit for more of the newest bars, or from and to (ISO) for a window. The public window is the newest 300 bars of the period: a to before it needs member depth (Builder and higher plans) and answers 403 history_member_only otherwise, except daily and coarser price bars, which stay open to every plan.

limit.description: number, optional newest bars, 10..5000; the plan's depth caps it (default 300 without from)

metric.description: string, metric key, e.g. price, oi, funding, liquidations (list: /api/series/metrics)

period.description: string, optional bar period: 1m | 3m | 5m | 10m | 15m | 30m | 1h | 2h | 4h | 6h | 8h | 12h | 1d | 3d | 1w | 1M (default 1h; each metric has a finest period)

symbol.description: string, optional Binance USDT-M perp or coin, e.g. BTCUSDT or BTC (default BTCUSDT)

to.description: string, optional ISO end (default now); a to before the newest 300 bars of the period needs member depth, except daily and coarser price bars

venue.description: string, optional venue id for price, oi, funding or borrow, e.g. okx (default binance)

name: get_series
